data.long_meaning: From the Old English words 'eppa' meaning horse and 'sweor' meaning soldier. This name was common among early English knights. The name Epperson carries the meaning “Horse soldier” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Epperson usually hope their child will grow to embody horse soldier and live with faith, good character and purpose.
